 "topology": "3-stage current-starved ring (NMOS starve on vctrl, PMOS mirrored) + 2-inverter output buffer",
 "rationale": "Three starved stages give the highest f for the least switched charge. The NMOS starve device has its gate on vctrl; near Vth (0.7 V) it is close to subthreshold, which gives tuning ratio well above 30. A 1:k mirror keeps reference power small. Nodes of about 5 fF make dynamic power about 0.15 mW at 2.4 GHz. The buffer gives rail-to-rail vout into CL. A 0.5 fF coupling cap passes the kick from vout into the ring."}

PARAMS = {
    "I_mid":   (180e-6, 60e-6, 400e-6),   # starving current per stage at mid vctrl
    "L_st":    (0.3, 0.15, 0.8),          # starve-device length (higher L -> less DIBL, more ratio)
    "k_mir":   (4.0, 2.0, 8.0),           # reference-branch : starver ratio (1:k)
    "Wn_inv":  (0.42, 0.42, 1.5),         # ring inverter nfet width
    "Wp_inv":  (0.84, 0.42, 3.0),         # ring inverter pfet width
    "Lp_ref":  (0.3, 0.15, 0.8),          # PMOS mirror length
    "Wbuf":    (1.0, 0.42, 6.0),          # output buffer nfet width (2nd stage)
    "Ckick":   (0.5e-15, 0.2e-15, 2e-15), # vout->ring coupling for kick start
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vlo, vhi = spec["vctrl_range"]; vmid = 0.5 * (vlo + vhi); VDD = 1.8
    Lst, k, Lp = p["L_st"], p["k_mir"], p["Lp_ref"]
    # --- NMOS starver width from forward model at mid vctrl
    o1 = lut.op("n", 1.0, Lst, vmid, 0.3)
    Wn_st = max(0.42, p["I_mid"] / max(o1["Id"], 1e-12))
    Wn_ref = max(0.42, Wn_st / k)
    k_eff = Wn_st / Wn_ref
    Iref_mid = p["I_mid"] / k_eff
    # --- PMOS diode reference & mirrored starvers (same L, same current density)
    mpr = lut.size("p", 8, Lp, Iref_mid, vds=0.9)
    Wp_ref = max(0.42, mpr.W)
    Wp_st = Wp_ref * k_eff

    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    n.M("MNR", "pb", "vctrl", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn_ref, Lst)
    n.M("MPR", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp_ref, Lp)
    nodes = ["n1", "n2", "n3"]
    for i in range(3):
        a, y = nodes[i], nodes[(i + 1) % 3]
        n.M(f"MNS{i}", f"sn{i}", "vctrl", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn_st, Lst)
        n.M(f"MPS{i}", f"sp{i}", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp_st, Lp)
        n.M(f"MN{i}", y, a, f"sn{i}", "vss", "nfet", p["Wn_inv"], 0.15)
        n.M(f"MP{i}", y, a, f"sp{i}", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wp_inv"], 0.15)
    # --- output buffer: small inverter then sized inverter (vout in phase with n3)
    n.M("MB1N", "b1", "n3", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 0.15)
    n.M("MB1P", "b1", "n3", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.84, 0.15)
    n.M("MB2N", "vout", "b1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wbuf"], 0.15)
    n.M("MB2P", "vout", "b1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * p["Wbuf"], 0.15)
    n.C("CK", "vout", "n1", p["Ckick"])       # lets the testbench kick reach the ring

    # --- predictions
    Cox = 8.5e-15  # F/um^2
    Cg_inv = Cox * 0.15 * (p["Wn_inv"] + p["Wp_inv"]) * 1.3
    Cd = 1.0e-15 * (p["Wn_inv"] + p["Wp_inv"])
    Cnode = Cg_inv + Cd + 0.7e-15 + (Cox * 0.15 * 1.26 * 1.3 / 3)
    def fosc(vc):
        I = lut.op("n", Wn_st, Lst, vc, 0.3)["Id"]
        return I / (3 * Cnode * VDD), I
    flo, _ = fosc(vlo); fmid, Imid = fosc(vmid); fhi, _ = fosc(vhi)
    # high-end limit from intrinsic inverter speed
    fcap = 12e9
    fhi = 1 / (1 / fhi + 1 / fcap); fmid = 1 / (1 / fmid + 1 / fcap); flo = 1 / (1 / flo + 1 / fcap)
    CL = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    Cbuf = Cox * 0.15 * 3 * p["Wbuf"] * 1.3 + 2e-15
    P = VDD * Iref_mid + (3 * Cnode + Cbuf + CL + 3e-15) * VDD ** 2 * fmid
    return n, {"f_lo": flo, "f_mid": fmid, "f_hi": fhi, "fmin": flo, "fmax": fhi,
               "tuning_ratio": fhi / max(flo, 1.0), "kvco": (fhi - flo) / (vhi - vlo),
               "swing": 1.75, "power": P}
